text:
The conviction should not be reversed if the jurisdiction recognizes that knowingly distributing a dangerously weakened medication can constitute murder when it accelerates death, even if the victim was already terminally ill. The president’s deliberate act of shipping the defective drug, with awareness of its substandard strength, supplies the requisite malice or extreme recklessness for murder. The fact that the patient would have died soon anyway does not negate causation, as the defective drug hastened death.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
